text: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a decline of 23,000 nonfarm payrols in July. Labor force participation fell to 61.4%, household employment declined, and private payrolls increased while government employment decreased. Healthcare and construction added jobs as multiple sectors recorded employment declines.

meta.note: Government and private employment moved in opposite directions but remain part of the same employment release.

text: Sen. Bill Cassidy announced support for Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general, providing the reported votes required for Senate confirmation assuming no additional changes in support. Opposition from other Republican senators remained recorded while the confirmation vote had not yet occurred.

meta.note: Vote commitments reached the reported confirmation threshold, but the formal Senate vote had not yet taken place.
